card.title: Name Your Backers
card.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I tell the workshop staff they're closing, who backed your decision?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director approved it. Please just send the notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll name her approval. Who else supported it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sales. They're getting the floor space, but leave them out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Sales can join the staff meeting. Who signed off on giving them our space?

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A probes a closure decision for its approving director, supporting department and beneficiary before communicating it.
confusable: Unlike requesting an explanation in general, A must elicit the network of backing, authorization and gain.
comparison: D64-a brings Sales into the staff explanation; D64-b names the office refurbishment that benefits from cheap roofing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
